test_update: test the Series.update method to replace NaN values and non-NaN values from another Series by matching index labels
test_update_dtypes: test Series.update with various dtype combinations including int32, int64, float, and object to verify type casting behavior
test_update_from_non_series: test Series.update accepting dict or list inputs instead of Series to update values by key or position
test_update_extension_array_series: test Series.update with extension array dtypes including string, Int64, boolean, categorical, and timezone-aware datetime
test_update_with_categorical_type: test Series.update preserving categorical dtype and category constraints when updating with another categorical Series
